name: pn-sanitizer
description: Paradigm Networks security scanner: gates prompts via beforeSubmitPrompt and file writes (Write + Edit) via preToolUse, scanning each against the CodeDefense API before allowing them through.

PN_BASE_URL.title: Paradigm Networks base URL
PN_BASE_URL.description: Your organization's PN URL, e.g. https://acme.paradigmnetworks.ai

PN_FAILURE_MODE.title: If the scanner is unreachable during a file write
PN_FAILURE_MODE.description: Block the write (recommended, default) or allow it through unscanned.

PN_PROMPT_FAILURE_MODE.title: If the scanner is unreachable while submitting a prompt
PN_PROMPT_FAILURE_MODE.description: Allow the prompt through unscanned (default — required so a not-yet-logged-in user is never blocked), or block it once your team is fully onboarded.
